'''Iain Reid''' won the [[1996 Kiffex Regionals (Loughborough)]], a qualifier for the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec96">[http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Regional Championship Finalists], Decipher (1996). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19961121232352/http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Internet Archive]</ref>
